verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents raw data exports (cases, screening, transactions as CSV) and case filtering. It shows no metrics or analytics view that reports dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload. Computing these figures from exported records would be a user-side workaround built from data primitives, which earns no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
